title: Thanksgiving Hymn to the Creator (Ki Jingrwai Ai-nguh Blei)
cultural_context: Classical devotional hymn offering gratitude to U Blei (God Almighty) for life, rain, harvest, and clan protection, from the 1930 collection.
lyrics_khasi:
Ngi ai nguh ia Me, ko Blei,
U Nongthaw u Nongbuh,
Ba la ai ia ngi ka sngi
Bad ka jingshai ba phuh;
Ia ka um ba tuid thiang,
Ia ki soh ba la sdieh,
Ia ka ri ba itynnad
Ba ki kpa ki la rieh.

Kupar bha Me la theh
Ha ka kpoh ka Meiramew,
Ngi kyntiew la ki kti
Ban burom ia la U Blei;
Ri ia ngi ha ka hok,
Pynsuk ia ki kur ki kha,
Ban im tip-blei tip-briew
Ha ka pyrthei baroh.
lyrics_english:
We offer our thanksgiving unto You, O God,
The Supreme Creator and Sustainer,
Who has gifted us the sun
And the resplendent morning light;
The sweet flowing crystal waters,
The fruit ripe upon the bough,
And this magnificent motherland
Where our fathers found sanctuary.

Abundant blessings You have poured
Into the womb of Mother Earth,
We lift up our hands
To venerate our God;
Preserve us in righteous conduct,
Grant peace to maternal and paternal kin,
To live honoring God and respecting mankind
Throughout the whole wide world.

khasi: Ngi ai nguh ia Me, ko Blei,

english: We offer our thanksgiving unto You, O God,
Who has gifted us the sun

khasi: Ban burom ia la U Blei;

english: Into the womb of Mother Earth,

vocabulary.nongthaw nongbuh: the Creator and Arranger (supreme Khasi divine title)
vocabulary.tip-blei tip-briew: revering God and respecting humankind (the supreme Khasi virtue)
